entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Stop following me... Just leave me alone!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why...? Why do you keep worrying[n]about me?

entries.speaker: Ann

entries.en: She probably just got dumped[n]or something. Leave her alone.

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Woman
entries.en: Yeah, you're right. It doesn't have[n]anything to do with us...
